name: The Coin Mill
description: An ancient Izzet stone machine in the catacombs that mints gold coins from copper, missing a crescent piece that Bazda holds.

timeline.summary: Terrik finds an Orzhov pontiff using abused wurms and spirits to dig for a missing piece of an Izzet coin machine.
timeline.quote: Faster! It's got to be buried around here somewhere,

timeline.summary: Ambrellin repairs the coin mill with Bazda's artifact and Savaryn pushes it, producing gold to pay off everyone's debts.
timeline.quote: The first gold coin tumbles out the chute, and I catch it in my hands.
